parent_scope_objection: Second and final opinion; initial1spent for each key. Initial exclusions rely on authors calling onlyExperiment1replication andExperiment2a novelChineseidiom study. Codebook says actual empirical relationship, not label: a new language/population/material extension can retest a specific earlier finding. Current GeneralDiscussion explicitly says shorter terminal-word fixations replicate EnglishUnderwood2004ANDtranslatedChineseCarrol/Conklin2015, wholeidiom shorter gazes replicateSiyanovaChanturia2011, and own Results agree with these experiments. Those are own new-data comparisons, not merely background literature by default; post-hoc comparisons are not automatically ineligible. For Cutter2014, inspect whether new idiom n+2preview design tests the same multiword-unit processing claim using altered predictability, or only borrows motivation/stimuli for a substantively different claim. Resolve EACH actual finding and closest-paper chain, not every same-method citation; do not count all historical sources just because cited either. Read full rationale, original-specific Results/Discussion and full references, all shipped identities and earlier Luna/initial objections. Differentlanguage/task or novelty alone cannot prove exclusion. Positive missing pairs require true original-specific empirical retest and distinct original experiment/report. No inferred outcomes; no title/year/DOI-only absences. Preserve actual scope limits if evidence cannot decide.
